list.title: Account types
list.subtitle: Decide how you group your accounts: savings, credit card, digital wallet or whatever you use. Only you can see your account types.

empty.allBody: Create the first one so you can group your accounts.
empty.searchBody: Try another word or clear the search.

deactivate.question: Deactivate “{{name}}”? You will not be able to use it on new accounts; accounts that already have it keep it.

form.createSubtitle: Give it a clear name and a description that reminds you which accounts belong here.
form.editSubtitle: Changes apply to every account that uses this type.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Cards with a credit line paid off every month

tips.label: Tips
tips.title: Before you save
tips.short: A short name reads better in lists and reports.
tips.unique: The name cannot repeat one of your other account types.
tips.private: Only you can see your account types.
